what.text: This page follows refugees from Gabon in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 984 Gabonese refugees, and France hosted 76.3% of them.
After France, the largest hosts are Canada, the United States and Belgium.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Gabon, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 17 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
